incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (region: us-west-2). p99 latency spike above 1s for the last 5m. Streaming stalls observed. Auto-incident created. Thread: 1871112222

alex: Acknowledging, paging oncall. @lee can you take first look? Looks correlated with recent traffic spike + several long-context requests.

lee: On it. digging into traces and kv cache metrics. attaching quick query results.

lee: ```
metric: model_inference.latency.p99: 1450ms (5m avg)
metric: model_inference.latency.p95: 380ms
metric: kv_cache.evictions.rate: 3200/min (baseline 120/min)
metric: kv_cache.size_per_shard: [67MB, 3MB, 0.5MB, 70MB]  <-- high skew
logs: streaming stall detected at decode step for request id=rc_9a1c
```

lee: Initial hypothesis: KV cache fragmentation/pressure causing eviction cascades. Some shards are full while others underutilized -> eviction thrash when large-context requests land on hot shards. Also we see prefill rate >> decode rate for some streaming clients (prefill bursts queuing up and causing tail stalls).

maria: Noted. Any immediate customer impact? p99 for the endpoint is failing SLOs so we should prepare an RCA+customer note. Which customers are affected?

lee: From sampling, ~2.8% of requests in last 10m exceeded 1s; top affected tenants: acme-inc (heavy long-context), beta-chat (streaming lots of short bursts), internal-eval.

sam: For mitigation: we can do a quick config flip to reduce prefill concurrency and increase kv_cache_shard_count for the pool. Propose:
1) route streaming traffic to smaller model variant (fallback-model-medium) for 15m
2) set prefill.max_concurrency=2 for the affected route
3) bump kv_cache.shards from 4 -> 8 (requires rolling restart of that worker pool)

sam: Commands (internal ops API):
```bash
# route to fallback variant
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.local/api/v1/routes/route-xyz/override" -d '{"model":"fallback-model-medium","reason":"mitigate kv thrash"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

# reduce prefill concurrency
curl -X PATCH "https://control-plane.local/api/v1/routes/route-xyz/config" -d '{"prefill":{"max_concurrency":2}}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

sam: Rolling restart command for shard compaction (k8s):
```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/model-worker-pool-7  # target pool in us-west-2
```

lee: I'll apply the prefill change now and watch. If we still see holes, I'll kick the rolling restart.

alex: Please post back with short customer-facing summary once we have triage. Also add me when you hand off.

lee: Applied prefill throttle. monitoring...

lee: 2m after change: p99 dropped to 820ms, p95 steady at 360ms, kv_cache.evictions.rate down to 400/min. Streaming stalls reduced in sampled traces.
